name: Snap Mechanic — Storage Tubes
description: Tap a marble on the belt to snap every marble of that color into a side tube. Tap a tube to send its top color group back. Two tubes, 9 each, LIFO order.
howToPlay: Tap any marble on the conveyor to store all marbles of that color in the active tube (left fills first, then right). Tap a tube to release its top color group back onto the belt. Use it to relieve a crowded belt or set up clean sorting runs.

showcaseLevel.name: Snap Showcase
showcaseLevel.desc: Store and return colors to keep the belt clear
